title: Warburg Pincus in talks to buy 20% of Go Digit, sources say
body: Warburg Pincus is in advanced talks to acquire a 20% stake in Go Digit General Insurance Limited from existing investor Fairfax Financial Holdings, according to three people aware of the discussions. A term sheet has been signed, but the transaction remains subject to due diligence and to approval from the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India. Fairfax currently holds 45% of Go Digit. Both parties declined to comment.
